branch_pattern.description: ERE the PR head branch must match (pipeline PRs only); empty = any same-repo branch

engine.description: engine adapter id recorded on the ledger entry (issue #230) — the engine this stage invokes; callers pass the resolved .ai-sdlc.yaml engine.name when per-stage dispatch lands (epic #220)

ledger_head.description: upstream run-ledger chain head — seeds this stage entry prev; empty = recover the ai-sdlc:ledger-head marker on the PR (issue #196)

log_max_bytes.description: byte cap per failing check log tail

log_tail_lines.description: log lines kept per failing check

max_failed_checks.description: failing checks whose logs go into the repair prompt

max_repairs.description: repair attempts per PR before needs-human (.ai-sdlc.yaml merge.max_repairs)

provider_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible inference base URL; empty → vars.AI_SDLC_PROVIDER_URL → GitHub Models default

runbook_max_bytes.description: byte cap on the injected runbook advisory (0 disables injection; issue #188)

runtime_ref.description: ref of os-santiago/ai-sdlc to fetch trusted runtime scripts (repair-stall-guard.js, failure-runbook.js, alert-router.js) from — pin to the same ref as this workflow

stall_max.description: repair attempts tolerated per identical failing-check signature before needs-human; 0 disables the stall guard (issue #190)

ledger_head.description: sealed run-ledger chain head for this repair run (issue #196)

AI_SDLC_APP_ID.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App id — mints the installation token the pushed fix uses to re-trigger CI (fail-closed when unset; issue #26)

AI_SDLC_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App private key (PEM) — pairs with AI_SDLC_APP_ID

AI_SDLC_LEDGER_KEY.description: run-ledger signing key (PEM; Ed25519/RSA) — seals stage evidence; absent = unsigned seal (issue #196)

MODEL_API_KEY.description: optional direct provider key; absent → GitHub Models via GITHUB_TOKEN
